messages.subject: For François Jackow | Industrial decarbonisation, government relations and ESG execution
messages.body:
Dear Air Liquide Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. François Jackow, Chief Executive Officer.

Air Liquide's industrial decarbonisation, hydrogen and energy-transition agenda operates at the intersection of public policy, infrastructure investment, sustainability and stakeholder confidence. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters and also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I also coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and industrial transition experience might support Air Liquide's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Air Liquide.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
